flagship_directive: Construct a least-favorable family entirely within the fixed positive-density band that proves the lower rate n^{-1/{1+d/(2gamma)+d/(4s)}} uniformly below the elbow, thereby matching the delivered cross-pair upper bound and completing the positive-band minimax frontier.
critique: The note proves a uniform density-free upper bound over the first-difference region and a matching positive-band minimax rate only when s is at or above the elbow. Below the elbow, the proved lower bound is the strictly weaker pointwise-regression rate, so the positive-band minimax frontier remains unresolved rather than merely technically incomplete. The title and the name “rank-feasible local HOIF” misdescribe the delivered method: the estimator is an order-one close-pair ratio containing no empirical Gram matrix, Möbius stabilization, or higher-order influence-function construction. Attainment beyond alpha, beta, gamma at most one is also unproved, with only a saturated first-difference robustness bound available. These gaps, together with limited comparison against precise published theorem statements and no computational assessment of the quadratic pair construction, keep the completed package below the strongest leading-journal contributions.
